displayName: DOM Get first child XML element

params.name: childElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the first child element

params.name: childElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the first child element

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the first child of an XML element, usable for further DOM navigation, and optionally its name and value.

jointConstraints.rule: childElemValue can only be passed if childElemName is also passed (the syntax nests childElemValue inside childElemName's optional group).
